newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore govt maintains ecomonic growth forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Singapore govt maintains ecomonic growth forecasts.

text.p: The Singapore government is maintaining its economic growth forecast for this year at five percent to seven percent, Finance Minister Dr Richard Hu told state television on Sunday.
Dr Hu was responding to Friday's growth projection of 7.2 percent by economists from the Nanyang Technological University (NTU) which he considered "on the high side".

NTU economists had said they were more bullish on the economy than the government, based on their view of synchronised growth for all major economic sectors, low inflation worldwide and a Singapore dollar that was unlikely to strengthen.
